sources.title: heapq — Heap queue algorithm
supports: Min-heap parent value is no greater than its children,so heap[0] is smallest
heappush adds an item while maintaining heap invariant
heappop removes and returns the smallest item while maintaining invariant
List representation uses zero-based child indices2i+1/2i+2;insertion is at array end before restoration
Official source replaces root with last item and restores parent-child relation;didactic swaps are not claimed as literal implementation assignments
